keyword: google review strategy that actually works
angle: A data-backed system for generating, responding to, and leveraging Google reviews to rank higher in local search and win more customers.
secondary_kw: how to get more google reviews

stats.claim: 97% of consumers read online reviews when evaluating local businesses
68% of consumers require a 4-star rating or higher before choosing a business — up from 55% in 2025 — and 31% now demand 4.5+ stars
80% of consumers are more likely to visit a business that responds to every review; 42% actively avoid businesses that never respond
Review signals account for 20% of local pack ranking weight — the second-largest ranking category after Google Business Profile signals (32%)
stats.source_name: Whitespark / BrightLocal Local Search Ranking Factors 2026

stats.claim: Businesses see a measurable Maps ranking increase when they cross from 9 to 10 Google reviews — a threshold not repeated at higher counts

Analysis of 50.4 million search results shows top-3 local pack businesses average 4.8–4.9 stars; a minimum of 4.3–4.5 stars is needed just to compete, with median review counts ranging from 28 (general contractor) to 976 (breakfast restaurant)
stats.source_name: Local Falcon Whitepaper: 50 Million Search Results Study (January 2026)
